note: Weights are Sufficit's editorial judgement for business profiles, not a measured model. Use the score to order fixes and show progress; it does not predict results. visibility: 'public' can be read without login; 'owner' needs a screenshot from the user or a logged-in view.

items.fullMarks: Brand plus what it does, using a term customers search, with the keyword inside the first 30 characters.
items.commonFail: Brand name alone, or a slogan nobody types.

items.fullMarks: The first line says who it serves and the result they get, in the customer's words. With several products, each has one line.
items.commonFail: A list of services, adjectives or a slogan.

items.fullMarks: One real proof (number, client or result) and one next step pointing to the link, within 150 characters.
items.commonFail: No proof, no next step, or an invented claim.

items.fullMarks: The primary link delivers what the bio promised: a WhatsApp link with a prefilled message, booking page or landing page. The list stays short.
items.commonFail: No link, a login page, a broken URL or a long menu.

items.fullMarks: Three pins doing three jobs: how it works, a client case and who is behind it.
items.commonFail: Nothing pinned, or pins chosen by views instead of what they sell.

items.fullMarks: Named for buyer questions (results, testimonials, offer, how it works, FAQ), with consistent covers and current content.
items.commonFail: Old events, personal stories or vague titles.

items.fullMarks: Professional account, the category closest to what customers search and working contact buttons that someone answers.
items.commonFail: Personal account, wrong category or an unmonitored contact.

items.fullMarks: Regular recent posts that reinforce the promise in the bio, and recent comments answered.
items.commonFail: Weeks of silence, or questions left unanswered.

items.fullMarks: The first two rows show what the business does at thumbnail size, with chosen covers and short readable text.
items.commonFail: Generic art or frames that say nothing at small size.

items.fullMarks: A logo readable in a tiny circle or, for founder-led brands, a clear face; consistent with other channels.
items.commonFail: Long logo with unreadable text, or a dark distant photo.

items.fullMarks: Short, easy to say and spell, and the same on other networks where possible.
items.commonFail: Stacked underscores, numbers or a handle nobody can spell.

items.fullMarks: Active stories when viewed, or a routine the user confirms.
